cmd:
# Gitea needs initial setup via POST /install
# This creates the database and admin user
curl -s -X POST 'http://localhost:3000/install'   -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded'   -d 'db_type=sqlite3&db_host=localhost&db_user=root&db_passwd=&db_name=gitea&ssl_mode=disable&db_path=/var/lib/gitea/data/gitea.db&app_name=P3+Gitea&repo_root_path=/var/lib/gitea/repos&lfs_root_path=/var/lib/gitea/data/lfs&run_user=gitea&domain=localhost&ssh_port=22&http_port=3000&app_url=http://localhost:3000/&log_root_path=/var/log/gitea&admin_name=p3admin&admin_passwd=p3agentcell2026&admin_email=p3admin@localhost'   -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}' 2>&1 | tail -5

sleep 3

# Test
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/v1/version 2>&1
